title: e2e: remove unused pod restart helpers
body:

#### What type of PR is this?

<!--
Add one of the following kinds:

/kind documentation

Optionally add one or more of the following kinds if applicable:
/kind api-change
/kind deprecation
/kind failing-test
/kind flake
/kind regression
-->
/kind cleanup

#### What this PR does / why we need it:
Remove the unused WaitForNRestartablePods, FilterNonRestartablePods, and isNotRestartAlwaysMirrorPod helpers.

When #109703 was opened in April 2022, the question was whether the filtering behavior was incorrect or whether the functions needed clearer names and comments. The code has changed since then: commit [39302c49615](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/commit/39302c49615d56e0539569a47ebe2643d6ae340c) removed the GCP restart test, which was the last in-tree caller of WaitForNRestartablePods.

Searching all tracked files at the base commit, 400031d6953, shows:
- WaitForNRestartablePods has no references beyond its declaration and comment.
- FilterNonRestartablePods is called only by that unused helper.
- isNotRestartAlwaysMirrorPod is called only by that filter.

Consequently, renaming these helpers or changing their filtering behavior would retain code with no remaining in-tree consumer. This PR instead removes the obsolete helper chain, without changing kubelet behavior or introducing new rules for Pod recreation.

Possible future reuse alone does not establish a current requirement for retaining these helpers. If a future test needs similar functionality, its filtering requirements can be defined and tested against that concrete use case rather than inheriting these ambiguous semantics.

The change is limited to removing 59 lines from two files.

Fixes #109703

#### Special notes for your reviewer:
The unused-code finding is limited to the Kubernetes source tree. Two of these helpers are exported, so this is not a claim that no downstream project uses them. The E2E framework README allows external use while warning downstream users to expect API changes. Please consider whether removal is appropriate for these framework helpers.

Validation:
- git diff --check: passed.
- gofmt -l on both modified files: no output.
- Repository-wide search after the change: no remaining references to the removed helpers.
- go test ./test/e2e/framework/pod -skip '^TestFailureOutput$' -count=1: passed.
- The full package test run failed in TestFailureOutput on Windows due to a path mismatch in the expected output. The same failure was reproduced with the unmodified base files using a Go overlay.
- Full repository verification, integration tests, and E2E tests were not run.

No new tests were added because this change removes unused helpers without adding replacement behavior.
